fields.description: Dutch labels for this job as they appear in the Manuren sheet (one per line). Used to match rows on import. Matching is exact after normalising case and whitespace.
fields.label: Dutch Aliases (import matching)

fields.description: Keywords used later to resolve a free-text project diagnosis (e.g. "change mechatronic") to this job. Not used by the import.
fields.label: Diagnosis Match Keywords

fields.description: Project fieldnames (comma-separated) holding the OEM part number that anchors this job, used by the quotation builder. e.g. "mechatronic" for a mechatronic job, "clutch,flywheel" for a combined job. Leave blank for jobs with no specific anchor part (parts come from history only).
fields.label: Project Part Fields (quotation builder)

fields.description: Tokens (comma-separated) that identify items belonging to this job by matching the item code or item name, e.g. "mec, mechatronic, tcu" for Mechatronics or "clu, kop, koppeling" for Clutch. Used by the quotation builder to filter the DSG-compatible items down to this job's category.
fields.label: Item Match Keywords (quotation builder)
